messages:
Kaan Ozdemir: Hey everyone — Kaan here, first day on infra! Quick intro: ex-startup infra/devops, excited to dig in. Quick setup Q: tried to enroll my Mac into the MDM and got a permission error ("MDM profile not found"). Also which Slack channels should I join beyond #eng-runtime? Happy to share a fun fact: I cook a mean pide.

Elena Park: Welcome Kaan :tada: — so glad youre here. Join #eng-runtime, #devex, #oncall-rotation, and #all-hands. We'll do a short intro at 10:30 PT today. If IT already pinged you about MDM, follow their steps below. Ping me if you want a quick repo tour later.

Girish Menon: Hi Kaan, welcome! Can you paste the exact error message? Most MDM failures are fixed by re-running the enrollment installer from our deploy box. URL: https://deploy.redwood.com/mdm — also make sure youre on the office VPN or connected to the guest network when doing enroll.

Jules (IT): I pushed an enrollment to your device and kicked a retry. Try this sequence: 1) System Settings -> Profiles -> look for "Redwood MDM" and Accept. 2) If not there, open Terminal and run:

```
sudo profiles renew -type enrollment
```

Then reboot. If that still errors, run the installer:

```
curl -sSfL https://deploy.redwood.com/mdm/install.sh | sudo bash
```

Post the output here and Ill escalate.

Ben Carter: Welcome aboard Kaan! People Ops sent a welcome kit tracking email to the personal address on your form. Badge pickup is available 2pm at reception today — bring a photo ID. Also fill out the onboarding checklist so we can clear benefits and payroll: https://onboard.redwood.com/checklists/engineer

Yara Gomez: Hey Kaan :wave: — Im your buddy this week. Ping me for a walkthrough of the codebase, local dev setup, and anything about team norms. Fun fact reply: I once road-tripped across Iceland. :earth_americas:

Kaan Ozdemir: Thanks all — the error I saw was exactly: "MDM profile not found (code 404)". Running `sudo profiles renew -type enrollment` now. Also loving Iceland stories — Ill take tea over coffee any day.

Jules (IT): Gotcha. If renew returns nothing, run the installer command above. Ill keep an eye on the device provisioning logs on my side. :thumbsup:

onboarding-bot: Reminder: New hire orientation starts 2026-03-24 09:00 PT — calendar invite sent.

Elena Park: Cool — once MDM is green, Ill add you to the internal test cluster and give you commit access. See you at 10:30. :rocket:
